lines.text: Nirantar: a reinforcement learning controller for a battery shared by ten homes with frequent power cuts.
Every fifteen minutes, the policy picks one of ten battery actions, and a safety shield checks it.
Morning: homes start losing supply, and solar and the battery back them up.
Midday: solar surplus, plus some grid power, fills the battery by two p.m.
Evening peak: the battery powers the street, including the homes in a cut.
At nine p.m., the shield keeps a four-hour reserve.
Over the day, every home in a cut was served.
